pros: Securely stores and shares team credentials and sensitive information.
Autofill feature saves significant time and promotes strong, unique passwords.
Affordable solution for a small business with good team management features.
cons: Initial setup and organization of shared vaults can be complex due to the separation of personal and organizational management.
Browser extension might sometimes require manual locking/unlocking for updates or specific sites.
Occasional issues with autofill on certain websites or forms.
changed: Con 1: 'Initial setup and organization of shared vaults can take some time.' was replaced with 'Initial setup and organization of shared vaults can be complex due to the separation of personal and organizational management.' based on the note '[friction] After creating the organization the app jumps from Password Manager into a separate Admin Console with its own sidebar, so my saved CRM and note items were not visible where collections and members are managed.' This provides a more specific, thematic reason for setup complexity.
